title: End improvements
description: The end should remain barren but NOT boring
body:
#
# This mod *improves* the end (pun intended), adding features i felt were missing from the dimension, can be used alone for an enhanced end experience or with other end mods to make the end even better! ## Explore the new features this end mod has to provide!
All features
Crashed End Ships

The endermen were drunk driving the mf and it ended up in the ground, you can find enderite upgrade templates inside

Void Fire

Found in the end, the most dangerous fire in all of minecraft, can be made by lighting bedrock on fire

New Blocks

You can build with the new chorus wood set or make the best dungeons with the full endstone set, but ofcourse the fun doesnt END there ;)

Enderite

A new material found in the end highlands, midlands and barrens, when crafted with quartz can provide quite the updade to netherite armor and tools by making them have more durability and giving them void resistance, that's right, no more loosing your tools in the void!

Ender Chest Boats and Minecarts

Pretty self explanatory really, boats and minecrafts with enderchest in them, that's it

Chorus Pie

Acts like chorus fruit but teleports you way further

## **FAQ**
Can I Use this mod in a modpack?

Go for it!

Does it work with my favorite end mod?

Most likely yes, if not, report the issue on my discord server

What languages does the mod support

Currently the mod is translated into English, Polish and Dutch but I plan on adding more in the future

Why are the textures like that?

I'm not an artist nor do I know one, if YOU are an artist and would like to contribute to this mod, join the discord

Why no Fabric? Why no NeoForge?

Soon™

Why is the source not available?

It's like, REALLY bad, I may release it once I rewrite some stuff
